contexts.career: Independent work during an ML-focused career break · Aug 2025 – present

bullets.html: Llama rejected correct arithmetic answers for some numbers (e.g. 100, 404) but not others. On 22 cases where it rejected at baseline, three MLP activation edits cut rejection to 3/22.
Tested the edits with held-out unit selection and random controls; reverse patches also made selected, previously non-rejecting prompts produce rejection language.
Tests of these two numbers suggested different early MLP components and a shared later influence on correctness judgments.

olmo.heading_html: RL fine-tuning OLMo to withhold prohibited exam help

bullets.html: Built a custom PyTorch/Transformers/PEFT GRPO trainer for OLMo-3-7B-Think-SFT with LoRA, vLLM rollouts and {{reward}}; compared final-answer and whole-completion loss over 12 updates and 864 rollouts per run.

reward.expanded_html: binary LLM-judge rewards for policy compliance and answer correctness

bullets.html: Final-answer-only training increased rewarded answer tokens' relative likelihood in 47/51 eligible groups when saved reasoning was provided, yet fresh responses did not clearly improve.

Whole-completion loss raised withholding from 68/144 to 81/144 fresh responses to seen prompts. Without policy text, it never refused prohibited help or asked permission (0/24 each on development prompts), so gains remained policy-dependent. One run per loss scope; automated judgments.
Built an RL fine-tuning trainer with PyTorch, LoRA and vLLM batched generation.

meta.heading_html:
Senior Software Engineer – Meta

Jan 2024 – May 2025

bullets.html: Built notifications prompting non-admin users at high-value advertisers to appeal mistaken ad-account enforcements, unblocking $6.6M/year in revenue.

Ran experiments showing broader appeal notifications increased harm, as bad actors exploited gaps in the appeal process. Worked with data scientists and the abuse-prevention team to limit the rollout to high-value advertisers.

Fixed a multi-recipient concurrency bug, reducing notification failure rates by 70% for Facebook Pages, 30% for ad accounts and 8% for businesses; found the platform logging false-positive delivery successes.

orbit.heading_html: Orbit Wars – self-play RL training and evaluation system

bullets.html: Built a GPU-vectorized PyTorch simulator, entity-transformer PPO policy, self-play league and standalone export; measured ~4.1k end-to-end environment steps/s on RTX PRO 6000, including policy inference and PPO updates.
Diagnosed an evaluator that counted opponent crashes as wins; added fail-closed checks, built fixed, seat-balanced evaluation panels and checked train/export parity.
A post-competition policy won 98.0% against a mid-tier planner and 14.1% against the 13th-ranked agent (256 games each), but 0/32 against a top-10 agent.
Built a GPU-vectorized PyTorch simulator and RL training system (~4.1k end-to-end steps/s on RTX PRO 6000); caught an evaluator counting opponent crashes as wins and added safeguards.

An attention-pooling agent with egocentric inputs, trained on 10×10 and 20×20 boards, achieved 97.7% moves toward food in zero-shot 100×100 play. Probes and training-size ablations pointed to training-state coverage as a bottleneck.

tastebento.heading_html: TasteBento – graded LLM generation in a live app
tastebento.links_html: Live app · Connects people through shared tastes in films, books, music and food

bullets.html: Built hard checks for AI-generated facts and quizzes (format, grounding, non-triviality and quiz answers); an LLM judge with capped scoring weight reranked only candidates that passed.
Shipped parallel best-of-N generation with near-duplicate suppression; logged prompts, candidates and scores to support later post-training.

Audited 50 outputs from an earlier prompt: 48 passed hard validation checks, but 42 failed a soft specificity check for concrete details (dates, numbers or names). All 10 user-flagged outputs passed the hard checks, showing the hard checks missed what users disliked.

Develop and maintain a live social-discovery app based on users’ taste profiles (Next.js, Postgres/Supabase, Cloudflare), with parallel LLM generation, automated checks and reranking; implemented query parallelization and session-revocation checks for mutations.
Built a deterministic OpenEnv moderation environment with four task packs and episodes up to 150 steps; implemented thread-context and policy-lookup tools, typed actions and reward shaping.
Benchmarked four hosted LLMs in one-shot and multi-step tool-using modes; reported task scores separately from accumulated reward because models with equal scores earned different rewards.
